subject: Linguistics
title: Language Endangerment
description: A micro-lesson that makes Language Endangerment usable.

hook.text: A language dies roughly every two weeks—and with it, a unique worldview vanishes.

buildup.text: Of 7,000 languages, nearly half are expected to disappear by the end of this century.

discovery.text: Languages die when children stop learning them, usually under economic or political pressure.

twist.text: Welsh was nearly extinct but revived through schools and media—proof that death isn't inevitable.

climax.text: Each lost language erases knowledge encoded nowhere else—plant names, navigation, oral history.

punchline.text: When a language dies, a library burns.

quiz.question: How often does a language die on average?
